recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-40476 unless a future applied/published issue changes Device.conformsTo; handle FHIR-40289 and later terminology/search-parameter follow-ups separately.
issue_request: FHIR-40476 is a Published OO change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, asking to change Device.conformsTo.category from Coding to CodeableConcept after FHIR-39084. Its description text says DeviceDefinition, but the summary, related artifact, and OO minutes identify it as the Device companion to FHIR-40475.
initial_application: FHIR-39084 introduced the Device/DeviceDefinition conformsTo model and initially left Device.conformsTo.category as Coding. Commit 2cfdd9c8375 changed Device.conformsTo.category from Coding to CodeableConcept, and merge e78a90027f for PR #2636 lists FHIR-40476 and FHIR-40475 among the applied issues.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes device=Device, so source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml is current build input. FHIR-40475, the companion DeviceDefinition datatype issue, already has a separate no-change audit on the combined branch. OO minutes and a Zulip R5 changes thread support the CodeableConcept correction. Later FHIR-40289 concerns broader conformance option/subspecification modeling and remains Resolved - change required, preserving the CodeableConcept category datatype.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because current active Device source already defines Device.conformsTo.category as CodeableConcept with the expected example binding.
